name: aiu-campus-geography
crs_note: RFC 7946 GeoJSON: WGS 84 (EPSG:4326), coordinates are [longitude, latitude] in decimal degrees.

dataset.policy: No coordinate is invented. A feature with geometry_status UNMAPPED has geometry null. VERIFIED requires a polygon, a source, a source_date and MEDIUM/HIGH confidence.

sources.title: uniRank - Al Alamein International University location page
sources.provides: Plus Code RW8J+JWW and a map embed centred on 30.8116875, 28.9298125 (zoom 18). A point reference only; no building outlines.
sources.licence_note: Third-party site embedding Google Maps. Only the published point is used; no imagery or tiles are copied.

sources.title: EMCO Company Profile, September 2025
sources.provides: Names one campus building: 'Alamein University - Service Building B16' (HVAC and fire-fighting, New Alamein City). No coordinates or drawings.
sources.licence_note: Company brochure; used only as a textual name reference.

sources.title: Faculties & Scientific Departments, Vol. 2 (AIU)
sources.limitations: Dated October 2020. Architectural/planning material, not current satellite imagery and not surveyed GIS geometry. Shows planned facilities; none is assumed built or operational. Pages 4 and 6 are images: only their headings were read (text extraction); the labels on page 6 were NOT read.
sources.provides: Facility page headings (text layer): Administration Building, Conference Hall, Library, University Hospital, Student Entertainment. Page 6 labels and arrangement: not yet read.
sources.licence_note: Official university publication. Used only as a textual reference; no image or drawing is copied or traced into the dataset.
